data.mechanism: A competing model: the enzyme that loads leucine onto tRNA doubles as the leucine sensor, binding free leucine directly.
data.mechanism_beginner: One competing idea: the enzyme that loads leucine onto its transport molecule for protein-building doubles as the leucine sensor.
data.boundary: Proposed before the Sestrin2 model and never cleanly reconciled with it.
data.note: CONTESTED with LEU-SESN2. Two published leucine sensors, both from strong labs, never resolved head-to-head. Prime Contradiction Engine seed.
